text:
Amy: FYI incoming "Emerald" POC — they want a 30‑day trial + 40% off first year. Customer wants to sign this week, can we fast-track?
Ben: who owns the commercial for Emerald? need ARR target, current usage estimate, and whether they want dedicated or hosted.
Amy: CSM said ~$120k ARR potential, hosted for now. primary ask is the 40% off and a one-month free trial credit.
Sanjay: quick note — our documented fastpass cap is 35% discount without exec review. 40% will require Deal Desk + RevOps signoff. we can split: 35% on commit + $X trial credit.
Jessica: Agree with Sanjay. Also need security questionnaire from the buyer before we finalize (they're enterprise). Can we give temporary access for POC while SQ is in progress?
Ben: For speed: propose this flow — trial credit applied to invoice as a one‑time credit, commit discount set at 35% for year1, and outline an escalation for +5% if AM/GM approves. Does RevOps need a formal Jira?
Sanjay: Yes create a Deal Desk ticket. Please include: customer name, ARR, contract term, requested discount, reason (competitive win), and SOW/POC dates. I'll tag finance for uplift.
Amy: I'll open the ticket now. copying the quick pricing snippet we plan to use:
```
SKU: RNW-HOST-GEN-1
List: $100,000/yr
Commit: $100,000 -> Discount 35% = $65,000
Trial credit: $5,000 one-time invoice credit applied during onboarding
```
Ben: Looks good. Add clause: "discount expires at renewal; renewal priced at list unless new commit" — legal wants that.
DealDeskBot: Request logged: DD-4721 — assigned to Sanjay. Link: https://rwd.atlassian.com/DD-4721
Sanjay: I'll review DD-4721 now. If everything matches policy I can approve the fastpass 35% + trial credit. For the extra 5% we need AM signoff (please ping @Ben).
Amy: tagging @Ben for AM approval path. I'll also start the security questionnaire send. :thumbsup:
Ben: pinged AM. will update thread once I have verbal ok.
Jessica: I'll coordinate onboarding dates with customer — keep trial window calendar‑blocked tentatively.
Amy: thanks team — moving to Deal Desk ticket and SQ. I'll update when AM responds. :rocket:
